blocks.text: A CATACLYSM OF WATER - A most powerful cyclone (Feb 2000) struck a southern African coastal state, practically wiped out the whole nation, smashing thousands and covering the land in a grave of water. The news said it was the worst in their history and it was an unbelievable catastrophe. The Scripts predicted events like this crossing the century and events like this leading to the tribulation and Jer. 25:32-33, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth. And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried, they shall be dung upon the ground.

A VISIONARY TRUTH - Remember my vision, where | stood by the seashore and a great wall of water went over me and crossed the land as far as | could see? | took this to mean a destructive and spiritual sign. At this time, we are in a great former and latter rain revival. The elements are travailing in water as foreseen.

TREMENDOUS QUAKES - Record breaking quakes took place in 1999 such as Turkey and elsewhere. Super quakes will continue right into this Scripture. Rev. 16:19, And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath. Through the ministry, the scripts predicted the record breaking quakes through the century and beyond. The more the elements travail with great shakings the quicker Jesus will move to gather his elect. - “Behold, saith the Lord, O earth, ye have seen the least of the greater events to come” We are definitely living in the apocalyptic prophetic hour. These things and the volcanic eruptions are like a trumpet heralding his coming.

THE PREDICTED AGE OF KNOWLEDGE - The god of forces (electricity) plus optic and laser are bringing the people into a revolutionary time. And are combining the Internet, TV, computer, telephone and satellite into one unit of digital power and scientific wonders. It will a thousand times faster then bringing the earth together as one family! Also by cable broadband currents. This will be used for trade also. (Rev.18.) Dan.12: 4, speaks of the increase of knowledge. Plus the Scripts 30 years ago foretold of such events. It seems that people now are moving through a fantasy movie of illusion. Their appointment will end sooner than later. Let us rejoice in the spirit as we await the Lord’s appearance to us.

PROPHETIC REALITY - In the awesome period ahead for world. In these chapters, we will use some Greek interpretation of the King James. It will bring out some additional depth! Luke 21:11, ‘There will be mighty and violent earthquakes, and in various places famines and pestilence (plagues, malignant and contagious or infectious epidemic diseases, deadly and devastating). And there will be sights of terror and great signs from heaven.” This is exactly what is occurring in this momentous hour. The Scripts actually pointed out some of the words of the Greek through my writings. Amen! What a view! “Stay close to the Lord! Unexpected things are ahead!”

CONTINUING INTERPRETATION PROPHECY - Luke 21:25, “And there will be signs in the Sun and moon and stars, and upon the earth distress (trouble and anguish) of nations in bewilderment and perplexity (that is, without resources, left wanting, embarrassed, in doubt, not knowing which way to turn) at (the echo) the roaring of the tossing of the sea.” First Jesus spoke of the heavenly signs that would be occurring just before His coming! There are signs right now in the sun, moon (man landed etc.). The Sun cycles are changing and some droughts have struck the United States. (At the end of the century | predicted not Y2K, but the Sun and it's changing cycles that would affect the world and it certainly has!) And they say more are coming plus floods. The words echoing, roaring seas, hurricanes, typhoons, cyclones and tidal waves. It’s also symbolic of governments and people in an uproar. Note: Powerful twin tornados smashed Fort Worth, TX. The Scripts foretold of massive water damage and the USA broke all weather records. The age to the elect is running out.“The sand of time is upon the world.”
(The company no longer prints on the old type of paper, for now this will be the new paper.)

YEAR 2000 BEHOLD THE DESTROYER COMETH - Rev. 6:4, “And another horse came out, flaming red. And its rider was empowered to take the peace from the earth, so that men slaughtered one another; and he was given a huge sword.’ This confirms the Scripts we have two clues. The word flaming would mean atomic fire and given a huge sword (weapon) this would mean the great energy weapons of massive destruction. Plus new ones leading to atomic matter etc.

LO THE BLACK HORSE - Vr. 5.6, “When he broke open the third seal, | heard the third living creature call out, Come and look! And | saw, and behold, a black horse, and in his hand the rider had a pair of scales (a balance). And | heard what seemed to be a voice from the midst of the four living creatures saying. A quart of wheat for a denarius (a whole days wages), and three quarts of barely for a denarius; but don’t harm the oil and the wine!”

ANTI CHRIST COMMERCIAL BABYLON AND NUMBER 666 - Daniel tells us “through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper.” (Dan. 8:25) The Beast is identified with the number 666. (Rev. 13:18) It is important to note that the number 666 is associated with only one other thing in the Scriptures — gold! Solomon in the days of his great prosperity received 666 talents of gold a year into his treasury! “Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold.’ (Il Chron. 9:13) It seems plain that the reference to this sinister number in connection with gold is not accidental. Gold is the god of this world. As such it is associated with commercial Babylon and the Beast whose number is 666. NOTE - Dan.11:36-38, shows him with the god of forces and a strange god of which he honored with gold, and precious things. (Vr. 43 and Rev. 18:12) Commercial Babylon (Rev.18) shows that it is used in trading. James Chapter 5 shows the hoarding in the last days. Evidently it places an important role during the tribulation. Gold is 999 fine. Turn it upside down and it is 666. Rev.13:13-16 shows it is the numerical of the beast in buying and selling etc. Also Rev, 17:1-5, mystery Babylon shows a gold cup. So we see some powerful influences will come into play during the rule concerning his standard of international trade. “666” what you have read is a material equation of hell and destruction. In finality the apocalyptic wrath of God will wipe it from the face of the earth.

ALARMING EVENTS are coming soon of great magnitude that will shock and shake the world. Some bringing unexpected anguishes and dismay. The rising false messiah will command a digital mark in the heads and hand of his followers! Digital means it will work in diverse ways. Also spiritual speaking you might say.

PROPHETIC NEWS - The scripts predicted these events and said to watch the Pope, Israel and the USA. The second Pope in history John Paul II went to Israel. But he is the first one to recognize it as a state! President Clinton went to Asia, India and Pakistan (nuclear countries now) to try to avert future trouble! He helped China get into world trade group. We see the kings of the east preparing! (Rev. 16:12-13) Later after a period of peace, Asia and Russia will use our technology against USA and Israel.

THE GOVERNMENT - WASHINGTON DC - They call it Capital Hill now wants to introduce a bill to give more children in school anti-depressant drugs like Retalin plus psychological drugs. They say while it may help some, it will only cause many to turn to heavier drugs as they grow up. What a startling age! Pray for your children and youth! America is sinking gradually like quick sand morally, etc. These scriptures are fulfilling Rev.3:17 and the counter part is Rev.17:5 plus Rev. Chapter 18.
